purpose: Candidate settlement-flavoured briefs for Architect's eval set v2 (A4/R8). Derived from Steward's concept-card fixtures and the LotBrief note format; the `notes` text is what a real Steward group item carries. In a group run they would also carry GroupRequest.context (settlement, site, purpose, street, neighbour lots).

request.notes: Part of a settlement: giant meteor crater, used as mining facility. Backstory: repurposed after the impact. Its role in the settlement is a ore_hall (design it as a custom building of that kind). Design it with its front facing south as usual; the mod turns the building so its entrance faces the street.
